claims.prior: The v1.1 recovery overlay enhances bottom detection.
claims.validated: The overlay adds trades but does not improve hit rates and slightly worsens weighted distance for SPY, QQQ and SOXX.

claims.prior: The monitor is a close-to-bottom detector.
claims.validated: It is primarily a staged drawdown-participation engine; QQQ and SOXX enter materially before eventual troughs.

claims.prior: Aggregate averages adequately describe model quality.
claims.validated: Episodes with final drawdowns of at least 25% are the principal failure regime and show very early, adverse deployment.

claims.prior: Positive forward return validates bottom timing.
claims.validated: Forward return is a secondary economic outcome; proximity and adverse excursion are the primary bottom-timing metrics.

claims.prior: Breadth reversal can confirm a final bottom.
claims.validated: Breadth describes participation and rebound quality but failed as a standalone bottom-completion trigger.

claims.prior: Financial or funding stress normalisation confirms the equity trough.
claims.validated: Stress can normalise during intermediate bear rallies; use it as context or a leverage veto.

claims.prior: The first v1.7 stress output is admissible.
claims.validated: The first output is invalid for promotion because breach age reset repeatedly; only corrected v1.8 is admissible.

claims.prior: Current-constituent sector panels can support production.
claims.validated: They are survivorship-biased discovery proxies and require historical point-in-time membership.
SMH remains informational only because paired rules did not show persistent incremental value.

claims.prior: A local recovery can be called a cycle bottom.
claims.validated: Participation, local recovery and cycle-bottom evidence remain separate states.

claims.prior: Actual-product leverage paths are not yet tested.
claims.validated: Actual adjusted-price product audits now exist for SSO, QLD and USD; all remain blocked from production.

claims.prior: SOXX to USD can be evaluated as ordinary tracking.
claims.validated: SOXX to USD is a cross-index tactical proxy; its gap combines benchmark mismatch and product path and is not pure tracking error.

claims.prior: All leveraged mappings have similar tactical risk.
claims.validated: USD showed a negative median tactical return, a worst trade near -23.24% and worst adverse excursion near -28.63%, materially worse than SSO and QLD in the audited rule.

claims.prior: The latest provider daily row can be treated as completed.
claims.validated: Providers may expose an unfinished current-session daily bar; the shared fetcher now excludes the current exchange-local row before a conservative 16:30 local cutoff.

claims.prior: The next priority is another price or rebound indicator.
claims.validated: The next priority is deep-bear capital reservation followed by authorised point-in-time feature ablation.
